text: Yes, the JRC map shows the 2023 loss. The observation tool indicates that tree-cover loss was observed in 2023 with an area of 0.7 hectares using the Hansen GFC dataset. Additionally, the JRC GFC2020 dataset confirms that the entire event area was mapped as forest in 2020. This corroborates the 2023 loss event as per the parameters set in the run metadata. The event meets the corroboration rule, which requires agreement between a later year of the series observed and the JRC 2020 reference on at least 50% of the event area.
